title: Item:Elixir of Spooky Luck
wikitext:
__NOTOC__
{{Top}}
Drinking this elixir grants your character an additional chance of finding {{Item|Night Revels Key}}s and {{Item|Piece of Darkest Chocolate|Darkest Chocolates}} from every chest you loot.
